title: Handling of Serving PLMN rate control

entities.name: Serving PLMN rate control
entities.description: A mechanism to protect AMF and signaling radio bearers from load generated by user data over control plane. Applicable only for PDU sessions established for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which SMF can inform UE of serving PLMN rate control.

entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which SMF can inform UE of serving PLMN rate control.

entities.name: Session Management Function
entities.description: Network function that informs UE of serving PLMN rate control and starts rate control when first control plane user data is received.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: Limits the rate at which it generates uplink control plane user data to comply with serving PLMN policy.

entities.name: Control plane user data
entities.description: User data transmitted over control plane, subject to serving PLMN rate control limitations.

entities.name: Rate control information discard condition
entities.description: Serving PLMN rate control information is discarded when UE successfully registers to another PLMN.

relations.description: Rate control applies to control plane user data transmission.
SMF can inform UE of rate control during PDU session establishment.
SMF can inform UE of rate control during PDU session modification.
SMF starts serving PLMN rate control when first control plane user data is received.
UE limits uplink control plane user data rate to comply with serving PLMN policy.
Rate control information is discarded when UE registers to another PLMN.
